name: Law Consolidation Phase Declaration
purpose: Declare the consolidation phase and establish governance boundaries for law family grouping and symbolic pruning.

phase_definition.canonical_statement: The law consolidation phase permits the reorganization of individual laws into governed families to reduce symbolic proliferation while strictly preserving historical law traceability.
phase_definition.core_principle: Prune by supersession and family consolidation, not deletion.
phase_definition.non_escalation_rule: Consolidation does not imply theorem promotion, physics support, or unification claims.

governance_rules.rule: No law may be deleted without an explicit supersession record in the trace registry.
All consolidated families must preserve the foundational ⇔R source relation and non-separability metadata.
Law families must maintain restricted-domain scope and analog-only status.
Counterexample and failure boundaries must remain visible in family-level documentation.

non_claims: Family grouping justifies physical substrate claims.
Relational inseparability collapses into ordinary equivalence.
